geometryIdentityScope: Saved mesh path/node/type only; no captured vertex-buffer hash.
poseHashEncoding: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(owner mesh local matrices in recorded path order, each element Number(value.toFixed(6))).
geometryHashEncoding: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify([{path,node,type}, ...]) in recorded path order.
limitations: Capture semantic paths require a production mapping.
Source fingerprint checks packaging inputs, not a new live scene capture.
Bounds expected coordinates are fixed from archived authored dimensions; actual coordinates must be sampled from live geometry separately.

dataIdentity.scope: Version 2 pins ordered featured and spine selections, titles, authors, featured cover URLs and length metadata. Sampled palette colors are excluded. Mesh identity, pose and projection checks remain required.
dataIdentity.textureContentLimitation: Data digest includes cover URLs, not remote response bytes. Runtime must still require decoded cover textures and valid mounted geometry.

verification.scope: Current mounted data is associated with the approved snapshot by identical retained geometry masks and all 13 owner colour buffers in light desktop. Other cases share exact owner pose hashes; their theme/viewport artwork is unchanged.
verification.textureContentLimitation: Data digest includes cover URLs, not remote response bytes. Runtime must still require decoded cover textures and valid mounted geometry.

boundsProbeProvenance.derivation: Top local bounds corners [signX * width / 2, thickness / 2, signZ * depth / 2]; authored dimensions verified against the archived centered roundedBoxGeometry constructor. These are nominal bounds corners, not beveled surface vertices.
boundsProbeProvenance.coordinatePrecision: Authored dimensions. Archived RoundedBox epsilon and Float32 positions expand nominal x/y bounds by approximately 0.000005 scene units; verified maximum discrepancy below 0.000006.
